source_basis: Lightfoot/Harmer1891 physical409–410 visually read; printed Greek working choices, not newly collated manuscripts.

decisions.evidence: Greek says nothing was appropriated for evil desire; it does not name a fund.
decisions.rationale: Avoid adding a particular payment or doctrinal corruption to the teaching-role description.

decisions.evidence: Source distinguishes conditional return, I do not know, impossible salvation for present intended denial, and repentance seems available for past deniers.
decisions.rationale: Do not harmonize these into either a blanket impossibility or an unconditional guarantee.

decisions.evidence: Printed hospitable overseers conjectural; A reported overseers and hospitable people. Corrupt Latin stones/hospitality phrase with editorial hosts-of-deacons proposal; reportedL2/Esupport.
full_English_alternatives: They are hospitable overseers, who always gladly welcomed God’s servants into their own homes without hypocrisy.
They are overseers and hospitable people, who always gladly welcomed God’s servants into their own homes without hypocrisy.
decisions.rationale: Expose the A alternative and status of conjecture; do not present the Latin editorial proposal as manuscript wording or establish later church hierarchy from this word alone.

remaining: Full witness/source audit, earlier English repairs, independent review, reader/artwork migration and publication.
